# tenferro v0.7.1

v0.7.1 moves to strided-rs 0.4.4, which restores CPU `select` (`where`) and
`clamp` throughput lost in v0.7.0. The public API is unchanged.

## Migration

- None. strided-rs requirements move to `0.4.4`.

## Performance

- CPU `select` no longer scans the boolean predicate byte by byte before every
  call, and float `clamp` tests NaN once per element instead of at both the
  maximum and minimum step. On M5 Max with 2^25 f64 elements, the strided
  erased `select` went from 16.2 ms to 8.2 ms at one thread and from 11.3 ms to
  3.8 ms at four threads, and `clamp` from 22.6 ms to 10.9 ms at one thread.
  ([tensor4all/strided-rs#277](https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/pull/277))

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1
